readers.pdf: continuous rendered pages; on-demand per-page PDFBox text mode and deep text search; no OCR; Android runtime pending
readers.docx: text paragraphs; no full Word layout
readers.epub: offline chapter text; no DRM or embedded images
readers.image: platform decoders and isolated SVG; external fallback

foreground_overlay: sticky foreground; stopWithTask false; task-removal callback and retry backoff; OEM restrictions still apply
delete_mode: same-volume recoverable trash, permanent purge requires separate confirmation
welcome: larger centred original logo, BAM - SERVICE at bottom; 5000ms
overlay_during_panels: suppressed while host activity/panels visible; restored on close or background; preference retained
internal_dialogs: shared rounded UiDialog/UiPanel, themed inputs and choices, recycled list rows
collections: persistent virtual URI sets; rename/move follows identity; references only
activity_log: local, max 500 entries; user-chosen CSV export

study_tools.selection: native selectable text in text mode
study_tools.clipboard: plain text and HTML rich text
study_tools.annotations: persistent local highlight/underline/note ranges keyed by source digest
study_tools.editing: cut and insert in local draft; original never rewritten
study_tools.export: one segment TXT/HTML with notes; user chosen new document
study_tools.crop: visible reader content PNG, draggable rectangle
study_tools.deep_search: opened document only, max 500 segments/200 results/45s between segments; cancel between segments

cloud.status: Project deployed and connected; Google/Facebook disabled pending provider credentials and mobile redirect configuration
cloud.login: external browser OAuth PKCE S256, state, single-use auth code
cloud.session: Android Keystore AES-GCM, refresh token, no client secrets
cloud.snapshot: private immutable chunks, SHA256, CAS, three recent versions protected
cloud.restore: exact IDs, attached SQLite transaction, durable preferences, local rollback
cloud.automatic: opt-in JobScheduler, unmetered default, minimum 15 minutes, subject to OS scheduling
